meta.name: doc-parse
meta.description: 将 PDF/PPT/Excel/Word 等多格式文档解析为结构化 Markdown，并输出元数据与解析置信度，作为 RAG 与四色卡片的数据底座。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 PDF/PPT/Excel/Word 文档解析为结构化 Markdown
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你需要把各种办公文档转成结构化文本，供知识库或检索使用
copy.tagline_en: Parse PDF, PPT, Excel and Word into structured Markdown
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to convert various office documents into clean structured Markdown for reuse

howto.what: 你给它一个已通过安全扫描的本地文件,它会把文档解析成结构化 Markdown,同时给出标题、页数、表格数等元数据和 0–1 的解析置信度,并说明最终生效的解析器。
howto.when: 当你提供已通过 security-scan 的本地文档(PDF、Word、Excel 等)并要求解析时,由密卷房 Worker 调用接管。

say.text: 把这个 PDF 解析成结构化 Markdown,并给出解析置信度。
say.note: 返回正文、元数据与置信度

say.text: 解析这份 Word 文档,告诉我标题、页数和表格数。
用三级 fallback 解析这个 Excel,说明最终用了哪档解析器。

howto.what_en: Point it at a local file that already passed the security scan and it parses the document into structured Markdown, returning metadata (title, page count, table count), a 0–1 parse confidence, and the parser that finally took effect.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you hand over a local document (PDF, Word, Excel, etc.) that has already passed the security scan and ask for it to be parsed; the Mijuanfang Worker calls it.

say_en.text: Parse this PDF into structured Markdown and give me the parse confidence.
Parse this Word file and tell me its title, page count and table count.
Parse this Excel with the three-tier fallback and say which parser was used.
